optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Technical Program Manager, Identity Provider Service

professionalSummary.text: Experienced Technical Program Manager with a proven track record of orchestrating staged production rollouts for identity provider services across multiple regions, ensuring high availability and minimal disruption to sign-in experiences.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the staged production rollouts of thirty-four identity provider changes across the five regions between 2022 and 2025, from the first canary region to full coverage, each on a rollout ticket in my name.

professionalSummary.text: Expert in conducting launch readiness reviews and maintaining rollout schedules, collaborating closely with engineering, SRE, and product teams.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the launch readiness review before each rollout and held the rollout schedule for the identity service, with the review minutes and the schedule in the identity launch folder.

professionalSummary.text: Skilled at monitoring rollouts with SRE, promptly halting or rolling back when sign‑in error rates exceed agreed thresholds.
professionalSummary.witness: Watched each rollout with identity SRE from the launch channel and halted four rollouts and rolled back one when the sign‑in error rate moved outside the agreed band; the five events are recorded on their rollout tickets.

professionalSummary.text: Proficient in planning rollout stages and region order in partnership with engineering teams, documenting plans before readiness reviews.
professionalSummary.witness: Planned each change's rollout stages and the region order with the engineering teams in the rollout planning session, recording the plan on the rollout ticket before the readiness review.

professionalSummary.text: Author of comprehensive launch records detailing residual risks, flag status, and hand‑over conditions for regional operations leads.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the launch record for each change, listing the residual risks, the regions where the change stayed behind a flag and the hand‑over conditions for the regional operations leads.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed 34 identity provider changes across five regions, ensuring smooth transitions from canary to full coverage.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the staged production rollouts of thirty-four identity provider changes across the five regions between 2022 and 2025, from the first canary region to full coverage, each on a rollout ticket in my name.

experienceHighlights.text: Conducted launch readiness reviews and maintained rollout schedules, producing minutes and schedules stored in the identity launch folder.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the launch readiness review before each rollout and held the rollout schedule for the identity service, with the review minutes and the schedule in the identity launch folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Monitored rollouts with SRE, halting four rollouts and rolling back one due to sign‑in error rate deviations, with events logged on rollout tickets.
experienceHighlights.witness: Watched each rollout with identity SRE from the launch channel and halted four rollouts and rolled back one when the sign‑in error rate moved outside the agreed band; the five events are recorded on their rollout tickets.

experienceHighlights.text: Co‑planned rollout stages and region order with engineering teams, documenting plans on tickets prior to readiness reviews.
experienceHighlights.witness: Planned each change's rollout stages and the region order with the engineering teams in the rollout planning session, recording the plan on the rollout ticket before the readiness review.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored launch records capturing residual risks, flag status, and hand‑over conditions for regional ops leads.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the launch record for each change, listing the residual risks, the regions where the change stayed behind a flag and the hand‑over conditions for the regional operations leads.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample: rollout tickets, readiness review minutes, and launch records for the last quarter, including four halted rollouts and one rollback.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the rollout tickets for the last quarter, the readiness review minutes for the same changes and the launch records for the four halted rollouts and the rollback.

skills.witness: Ran the staged production rollouts of thirty-four identity provider changes across the five regions between 2022 and 2025, from the first canary region to full coverage, each on a rollout ticket in my name.
Ran the launch readiness review before each rollout and held the rollout schedule for the identity service, with the review minutes and the schedule in the identity launch folder.

Watched each rollout with identity SRE from the launch channel and halted four rollouts and rolled back one when the sign‑in error rate moved outside the agreed band; the five events are recorded on their rollout tickets.
Planned each change's rollout stages and the region order with the engineering teams in the rollout planning session, recording the plan on the rollout ticket before the readiness review.
Wrote the launch record for each change, listing the residual risks, the regions where the change stayed behind a flag and the hand‑over conditions for the regional operations leads.
